name: resnet18-finetuned-cifar10
description: ResNet-18 fine-tuned on CIFAR-10 for teaching transfer learning.
intended_use: Coursework demonstrations of transfer learning in an undergraduate ML class.
limitations: Trained only on 32x32 CIFAR-10 images, so full-resolution photos degrade accuracy.
Coarse label set: the model confuses cats and dogs in low-light conditions.
